definition: the science of stars, planets, and everything else in space
sentence: Ace borrowed a book on astronomy to learn the names of the planets.

definition: the invisible force that pulls objects toward each other
sentence: Gravity keeps the Moon travelling around Earth.

definition: the curved path an object follows around a planet or star
sentence: The space station completes an orbit about every hour and a half.

definition: a huge group of billions of stars, gas, and dust held together by gravity
sentence: Our Solar System is one tiny part of the Milky Way galaxy.

definition: a tool that makes faraway objects look closer and larger
sentence: Through the telescope, Ace could see the rings of Saturn.

definition: an object that travels in orbit around a planet
sentence: A weather satellite sent pictures of the storm over the Pacific.

definition: the layer of gases that surrounds a planet
sentence: Earth's atmosphere protects us from most small space rocks.

definition: a rocky object, smaller than a planet, that orbits the Sun
sentence: Scientists track every large asteroid that passes near Earth.

definition: a group of stars that forms a pattern or picture in the night sky
sentence: The Big Dipper is part of a constellation called the Great Bear.

definition: a piece of rock from space that lands on Earth's surface
sentence: The museum displayed a meteorite that fell in a Canadian farmer's field.
